questions.scenario: Your school's Annual Day is coming up. Which role do you fight for?

options.text: The lead actor in the main stage play.
The lead singer or guitarist in the school band.
The center position in the mega group dance.
The main anchor/host holding the mic for the whole event.

questions.scenario: If you had to go viral on Instagram or YouTube, what would your video be?

options.text: Recreating an intense movie scene with great expressions.
A beautiful unplugged song cover or beatboxing.
Nailing a fast and energetic viral dance trend.
A funny, relatable comedy sketch or a roast video.

questions.scenario: You are standing alone in front of a big mirror. What do you secretly do?

options.text: Practice fake crying or angry movie dialogues.
Hold a fake mic (like a hairbrush) and hit high notes.
Check out my body movements, locking, or popping steps.
Talk to myself like I am giving an interview or hosting a show.

questions.scenario: You are performing on stage and suddenly the background music stops due to a power cut. What do you do?

options.text: Keep acting out the scene with intense facial expressions.
Keep singing loudly without the music (Acapella).
Keep doing the steps flawlessly to the beat playing in my head.
Start talking to the audience and crack a joke about the power cut.

questions.scenario: If you could have a magical stage superpower, what would it be?

options.text: Shape-shifting (Becoming any character instantly).
Perfect Pitch (Recreating any sound or melody perfectly).
Anti-gravity (Extreme flexibility, flips, and physical balance).
Mind-control (Making the entire crowd laugh or clap on command).

questions.scenario: Every art requires practice. Which of these 'boring' tasks can you happily tolerate?

options.text: Memorizing 10 pages of heavy dialogues word-by-word.
Doing vocal warm-ups (Sa-Re-Ga-Ma) for 2 hours straight.
Repeating one single jump or step 50 times until my legs hurt.
Writing and rewriting a joke 20 times to get the timing right.

questions.scenario: What is the best compliment someone could give you after a performance?

options.text: 'Your facial expressions gave me literal goosebumps.'
'Your voice is so magical, it touched my soul.'
'Your energy and moves are out of this world!'
'You are so confident, you completely controlled the crowd!'

questions.scenario: When you are feeling sad or stressed, how do you naturally release your energy?

options.text: I imagine myself as a character in a movie and romanticize the sadness.
I put on my earphones, isolate myself, and listen to deep music.
I physically move, stretch, or dance it out to feel lighter.
I use sarcasm or humor to hide it and make others laugh.

questions.scenario: What kind of YouTube videos do you binge-watch the most?

options.text: Behind-the-scenes of movie sets and actors giving interviews.
Studio recording sessions and artists making beats.
Dance battles, flash mobs, and choreography tutorials.
Stand-up comedy specials and late-night talk shows.

questions.scenario: In your friend group, what title suits you the best?

options.text: The Drama Queen/King (Very expressive and emotional).
The Playlist Master (Always humming or playing songs).
The Energy Bomb (Never sits still, always moving).
The Entertainer (The talkative one who cracks everyone up).
